title: Generating polynomial expansion
statement: Let $x$ be a sign assignment on $n$ coordinates and let $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$. The polynomial $\prod_{i=1}^n(1+x_iX)$, evaluated at $\rho$, equals $\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}\bigl(\prod_{i\in S}x_i\bigr)\rho^{|S|}$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign assignment on $n$ coordinates
